text: use the obsidian mcp semantic search tools. I want to know what I have said about why I am doing a pkm and what I think knowledge is for.

cmd: grep -rliE "why.*(pkm|zettelkasten|knowledge management|second brain)|knowledge is for|purpose of (this|my) (vault|pkm|zettelkasten)|why i (do|keep|built|started)" --include="*.md" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^./10_System" | head -50

find . -iname "*You Are the Zettelkasten*.md" -o -iname "*Zettelkasten System Essence*.md" -o -iname "*PKM as Process vs Product*.md" -o -iname "*I am iterating on creating a thinking system*.md" -o -iname "*Externalize Memory Aggressively*.md" -o -iname "*Extended Mind*.md" 2>/dev/null
